function.name: youtube_publish
function.description: Validate, save a local YouTube draft, dispatch an upstream draft/publish/schedule decision, upload, preflight, authorize, or disconnect. Draft/publish/schedule/dispatch require exact authorization plus commit=true.

decision.description: Required only for dispatch and must equal the manifest mode.

manifest.description: Absolute manifest path for validate, dry_run, draft, publish, schedule, dispatch, or legacy upload; otherwise null.

profile.description: Local authorization profile for auth, preflight, or disconnect; otherwise null.

client_secrets.description: Absolute Google Desktop OAuth client JSON path for auth only; otherwise null.

commit.description: True only after exact authorization for draft, publish, schedule, dispatch, or legacy upload; false otherwise.
